# Penumbra Forge Homepage Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (if subagents available) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a single-scroll homepage for penumbraforge.com using Eleventy (11ty) with Umbra's spectral design language.

**Architecture:** Static site generated by 11ty with Nunjucks templates. Data-driven product cards from JSON. Single CSS file with design tokens. GitHub Actions builds and deploys to GitHub Pages. Zero client-side JavaScript.

**Tech Stack:** Eleventy 3.x, Nunjucks, vanilla CSS, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-20-penumbraforge-homepage-design.md`

---

## File Map

| File | Responsibility |
|------|---------------|
| `package.json` | Project metadata, 11ty dependency, build/dev scripts |
| `eleventy.config.js` | 11ty config: input/output dirs, passthrough copy, filters (ESM format) |
| `src/_data/site.json` | Global site metadata, author info, umbra.launched flag |
| `src/_data/products.json` | Product card data (name, description, url, repo) |
| `src/_includes/base.njk` | HTML shell: doctype, head (meta, OG, CSS, JSON-LD), body wrapper |
| `src/_includes/footer.njk` | Shared footer partial |
| `src/css/style.css` | Complete stylesheet with design tokens, layout, responsive rules |
| `src/index.njk` | Homepage: hero, principles, umbra, products, about, footer |
| `src/robots.txt.njk` | Generated robots.txt (disallow /umbra pre-launch) |
| `src/sitemap.njk` | Generated sitemap.xml |
| `src/blog/blog.json` | Blog collection defaults (scaffold only) |
| `public/favicon.svg` | Spectral orb favicon |
| `public/og-image.png` | Open Graph preview card |
| `public/_headers` | Security headers for Cloudflare/GitHub Pages |
| `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` | CI: build 11ty, deploy to GitHub Pages |
| `.gitignore` | Ignore _site/, node_modules/ |

### Task 1: Project scaffold and 11ty config

**Files:**
- Create: `package.json`
- Create: `eleventy.config.js`
- Create: `.gitignore`

- [ ] **Step 1: Initialize git repo**

```bash
cd ~/penumbraforge
git init
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create package.json**

Create `package.json` with 11ty as the only dependency:

```json
{
  "name": "penumbraforge.com",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "Penumbra Forge — Independent software studio",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "eleventy",
    "dev": "eleventy --serve --watch"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "devDependencies": {
    "@11ty/eleventy": "^3.0.0"
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create eleventy.config.js (ESM format — required for 11ty 3.x)**

```js
export default function (eleventyConfig) {
  eleventyConfig.addPassthroughCopy("public");

  return {
    dir: {
      input: "src",
      output: "_site",
      includes: "_includes",
      data: "_data",
    },
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create .gitignore**

```
node_modules/
_site/
.DS_Store
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Install dependencies**

Run: `cd ~/penumbraforge && npm install`
Expected: `node_modules/` created, `package-lock.json` generated.

- [ ] **Step 6: Verify 11ty runs**

Run: `mkdir -p src && echo "hello" > src/index.njk && npx eleventy`
Expected: Output shows `_site/index.html` written. Delete the test file after.

- [ ] **Step 7: Commit**

```bash
git add package.json package-lock.json eleventy.config.js .gitignore
git commit -m "feat: scaffold 11ty project with config and build scripts"
```

### Task 3: Base template and footer partial

**Files:**
- Create: `src/_includes/base.njk`
- Create: `src/_includes/footer.njk`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create base.njk**

Full HTML shell with:
- `<!DOCTYPE html>` and `<html lang="en">`
- `<head>` block: charset, viewport, title (from page or site.title), meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, Twitter card tags, favicon link, inline or linked CSS
- JSON-LD structured data block (Organization + Person)
- `<body>` with `<header>` wrapping the hero section and `<main>` wrapping the remaining content via `{{ content | safe }}`
- Footer include
- Optional grain overlay div

The template must use Nunjucks blocks so pages can override `title` and `description`:
```
{% block title %}{{ site.title }}{% endblock %}
{% block description %}{{ site.description }}{% endblock %}
```

See spec sections "SEO & Meta" and "Structured Data (JSON-LD)" for exact meta tag content.

- [ ] **Step 2: Create footer.njk**

Semantic `<footer>` element with:
- Left: `© 2026 Penumbra Forge LLC`
- Right: links to GitHub (`https://github.com/penumbraforge`), email (`mailto:shadoe@penumbraforge.com`), Terminal (`/terminal` — accent colored), Privacy (`/privacy.html`), Terms (`/terms.html`)
- Flexbox layout, responsive: stacks vertically at ≤ 640px

- [ ] **Step 3: Verify template renders**

Create `src/index.njk` with:
```
---
layout: base.njk
---
<p>Test content</p>
```

Run: `npx eleventy --serve`
Open `http://localhost:8080`. Verify: valid HTML, meta tags present, footer renders, no JS errors.

- [ ] **Step 4: Commit**

```bash
git add src/_includes/base.njk src/_includes/footer.njk src/index.njk
git commit -m "feat: add base template with SEO meta, OG tags, JSON-LD, and footer"
```

### Task 4: CSS stylesheet

**Files:**
- Create: `src/css/style.css`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create style.css with design tokens**

CSS custom properties section at top of file using the spec's color palette:

```css
:root {
  --surface-0: #06060c;
  --surface-1: #0a0a14;
  --surface-2: #10101c;
  --border: #1e1e35;
  --border-active: #2e2e50;
  --accent: #b8a5d6;
  --accent-strong: #d4c4f0;
  --text-1: #e8e4ef;
  --text-2: #999;
  --text-3: #666;
  --muted: #444;
  --slate: #687a8e;
  --sage: #6bcf8f;

  --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Cascadia Code', monospace;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Add reset and base styles**

Minimal reset (box-sizing, margin, padding). Body styles: `background: var(--surface-0)`, `color: var(--text-2)`, `font-family: var(--font-sans)`, `font-size: 13px`, `line-height: 1.6`.

Link styles: `color: var(--accent)`, `text-decoration: none`, hover: `color: var(--accent-strong)`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add layout styles**

`.container` — `max-width: 560px`, `margin: 0 auto`, `padding: 0 24px`.

Section styles — each `<section>` has `padding: 48px 40px` and `border-top: 1px solid var(--border)`.

Section labels — `.section-label`: `font-size: 10px`, `letter-spacing: 3px`, `color: var(--muted)`, `text-transform: uppercase`.

- [ ] **Step 4: Add hero styles**

`.hero` — centered text, `padding: 80px 40px 60px`, radial gradient background.

`.hero-orb` — `width: 52px`, `height: 52px`, `border-radius: 50%`, radial gradient, box-shadow glow.

`.hero-studio` — `font-size: 11px`, `letter-spacing: 4px`, `color: var(--slate)`, uppercase.

`.hero h1` — `font-size: 26px`, `font-weight: 300`, `color: var(--text-1)`.

`.hero-subtitle` — `font-size: 13px`, `color: var(--text-3)`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Add principles row styles**

`.principles` — CSS grid, `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`, `gap: 24px`, centered text.

`.principles h3` — `font-size: 13px`, `color: var(--accent)`.

`.principles p` — `font-size: 11px`, `color: var(--text-3)`.

Responsive: at 768px → `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr)`. At 640px → `grid-template-columns: 1fr`.

- [ ] **Step 6: Add Umbra section styles**

`.umbra` — violet gradient background `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(184,165,214,0.03) 0%, transparent 100%)`.

`.umbra-header` — flex row with orb, name, status badge.

`.umbra-orb` — 28px circle, same gradient as hero orb.

`.status-dot` — 6px sage circle with box-shadow glow and pulse animation.

Pulse keyframes (inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`):
```css
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; }
  50% { opacity: 1; }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Add product card styles**

`.product-card` — `padding: 18px`, `border: 1px solid var(--border)`, `border-radius: 8px`, `background: var(--surface-1)`.

Hover: `border-color: var(--border-active)`, `transition: border-color 150ms ease`.

`.product-card-content` — flex row, space between name/description and arrow/source link.

`.product-card h3` — `font-size: 14px`, `color: var(--text-1)`, `margin: 0`.

`.product-card p` — `font-size: 12px`, `color: var(--text-3)`, `line-height: 1.5`.

`.product-name` — `text-decoration: none`, `color: inherit`.

`.product-source` — `font-size: 10px`, `color: var(--text-3)`.

- [ ] **Step 8: Add about section styles**

`.about` — violet tint background `rgba(184, 165, 214, 0.02)`.

`.about p` — `font-size: 13px`, `color: var(--text-2)`, `line-height: 1.8`.

`.tech-tags` — flex row, `gap: 16px`, `flex-wrap: wrap`.

`.tech-tag` — `font-size: 11px`, `color: var(--muted)`, `padding: 4px 10px`, `border: 1px solid var(--border)`, `border-radius: 4px`, `font-family: var(--font-mono)`.

- [ ] **Step 9: Add footer styles**

`.site-footer` — flex row, space-between, `padding: 24px 40px`, `font-size: 11px`.

`.footer-links` — flex row, `gap: 20px`.

`.footer-terminal` — `color: var(--accent)` (the easter egg).

Responsive at 640px: `flex-direction: column`, `text-align: center`, `gap: 12px`.

- [ ] **Step 10: Add grain overlay styles**

`.grain` — fixed position, full viewport, `pointer-events: none`, `z-index: 9999`, SVG noise filter as background, `opacity: 0.03`. Inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.

- [ ] **Step 11: Add scrollbar styles**

Thin custom scrollbar matching Umbra: 6px width, `var(--surface-2)` thumb, transparent track, rounded.

- [ ] **Step 12: Link CSS in base.njk**

Add `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/style.css">` to the base template `<head>`.

### Task 6: SEO files (robots.txt, sitemap, blog scaffold)

**Files:**
- Create: `src/robots.txt.njk`
- Create: `src/sitemap.njk`
- Create: `src/blog/blog.json`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create robots.txt.njk**

```
---
permalink: /robots.txt
eleventyExcludeFromCollections: true
---
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /umbra

Sitemap: {{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create sitemap.njk**

```xml
---
permalink: /sitemap.xml
eleventyExcludeFromCollections: true
---
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/sitemaps/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
  {%- for page in collections.all %}
  {%- if not page.data.noindex %}
  <url>
    <loc>{{ site.url }}{{ page.url }}</loc>
    <lastmod>{{ page.date | toISOString }}</lastmod>
  </url>
  {%- endif %}
  {%- endfor %}
</urlset>
```

- [ ] **Step 2b: Add toISOString filter to eleventy.config.js**

Add inside the `export default function` body, before the `return`:

```js
eleventyConfig.addFilter("toISOString", (date) => {
  return new Date(date).toISOString().split("T")[0];
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create blog collection scaffold**

Create `src/blog/blog.json`:
```json
{
  "layout": "base.njk",
  "tags": "blog"
}
```

This enables the blog collection when posts are added later. No posts, listing page, or feed needed yet.

Note: The spec's project structure lists `src/feed.njk` but also states "no feed until first post." `feed.njk` is intentionally deferred — create it when the first blog post is written.

- [ ] **Step 4: Verify SEO files generate**

Run: `npx eleventy`
Check:
- `_site/robots.txt` exists and contains `Disallow: /umbra`
- `_site/sitemap.xml` exists and contains `<url>` entry for homepage

### Task 8: GitHub Actions deployment workflow

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create deploy.yml**

```yaml
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: _site

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Commit**

```bash
git add .github/workflows/deploy.yml
git commit -m "feat: add GitHub Actions workflow for Pages deployment"
```

```bash
cd ~/penumbraforge
rm -rf _site
npx eleventy
```

- `index.html` (homepage)
- `robots.txt`
- `sitemap.xml`
- `favicon.svg`
- `og-image.png`
- `_headers`

- [ ] **Step 2: Local dev server check**

Run: `npx eleventy --serve`

Check in browser:
- Homepage renders correctly at `http://localhost:8080`
- All sections visible and properly styled
- Responsive at 768px, 640px, 375px breakpoints
- Pulse animation on Umbra status dot
- Product card hover states work
- Footer links have correct hrefs
- View page source: confirm valid semantic HTML, proper heading hierarchy (single h1)
- Check meta tags in `<head>`: title, description, OG tags, canonical, JSON-LD

- [ ] **Step 2b: Check CSS file size for potential inlining**

Run: `wc -c _site/css/style.css`

If under 14KB (~14336 bytes), consider inlining the CSS directly in `<head>` of `base.njk` for optimal performance (eliminates one network request). If over 14KB, keep the external `<link>` — the browser caches it on subsequent loads.

- [ ] **Step 3: HTML validation**

Paste the generated `_site/index.html` into the W3C validator or run a local check. Fix any issues.

- [ ] **Step 4: Commit any fixes**

```bash
git add -A
git commit -m "fix: address validation issues from final review"
```

### Task 10: Existing pages migration

The existing terminal site, `/gate`, `/librarian`, and `/tools` are standalone static HTML currently served from the rngdz GitHub account. Per the spec, the recommended approach is to copy them into `public/` as passthrough files so they deploy alongside the new pages.

- [ ] **Step 1: Copy existing pages into public/**

Copy the existing static HTML directories from the current rngdz repo into `public/`:
- `public/terminal/` — existing terminal site (becomes /terminal)
- `public/gate/` — Gate product page (becomes /gate)
- `public/librarian/` — Librarian page (becomes /librarian)
- `public/tools/` — Tool kits directory (becomes /tools)
- `public/privacy.html` — Privacy policy
- `public/terms.html` — Terms of service
- `public/game/`, `public/snake/` — Games (if keeping)

These are passthrough copies — 11ty doesn't process them, just copies to `_site/`.

Note: This step requires cloning/downloading from the rngdz repo. If the existing pages aren't ready to migrate yet, this task can be deferred — the new homepage will work standalone, and Cloudflare Workers can route `/gate`, `/terminal`, etc. to the old site temporarily.

- [ ] **Step 2: Verify all routes work**

Run: `npx eleventy --serve`
Check that `/terminal`, `/gate`, `/librarian`, `/tools` all load correctly alongside the new homepage.

- [ ] **Step 3: Commit**

```bash
git add public/
git commit -m "feat: migrate existing static pages as passthrough copies"
```

### Task 11: Push to penumbraforge GitHub account

This task requires Shadoe to be authenticated to the penumbraforge GitHub account.

- [ ] **Step 1: Create repo on GitHub**

Create `penumbraforge/penumbraforge.github.io` repo (or `penumbraforge/penumbraforge.com`). This must be done via the GitHub web UI or `gh` CLI authenticated as the penumbraforge account.

- [ ] **Step 2: Add remote and push**

```bash
cd ~/penumbraforge
git remote add origin git@github.com:penumbraforge/<repo-name>.git
git push -u origin main
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Enable GitHub Pages**

In repo Settings → Pages:
- Source: GitHub Actions
- Custom domain: `penumbraforge.com`

- [ ] **Step 4: Update Cloudflare DNS**

Update the CNAME record for `penumbraforge.com` to point to `penumbraforge.github.io`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Verify deployment**

After the GitHub Action completes, visit `https://penumbraforge.com` and verify the homepage loads correctly with HTTPS.

- [ ] **Step 6: Tag the release**

```bash
git tag v1.0.0
git push origin v1.0.0
```
